summary: Microsoft Azure for Students gives verified students $100 in Azure credits valid for 12 months plus access to 25+ always-free services (compute, storage, database, networking) with no credit card required at sign-up. Renewable each active student year.
claim_steps: Sign in with your school email and complete student verification via the Azure Education Hub.
Once approved, start building with $100 credit and free-tier services for 12 months.
